_meta.purpose: One entry per GitHub issue: what changed, where, how it was checked and what is left. Read this before starting an issue; update it in the same pull request that does the work.

status_values.in_progress: Someone is working on it; assignee and branch are set
status_values.on_hold: Do not start until the on-hold label is removed

how_to_update: Starting an issue: set status to in_progress, fill assignee and branch, and assign yourself on GitHub
Finishing: set status to done, fill commit (hash, date, message, files), changes, verification and deviations_from_issue
Changing something a finished issue built: add an entry to that issue's revisions with the commit and a one-line summary
Work that belongs to no single issue goes in other_changes
Anything the next person must know goes in follow_ups
